title: A Welcome in Every Language: Hilton Expands No-Cost Language Learning to All Team Members
summary: Hilton is expanding its Language Learning Program, giving team members access to multilingual learning resources at no cost.
body_markdown:
Listen to this article


0:00


More than 500,000 team members across Hilton’s global workforce can build language skills, confidence and connections through self‑study courses, live classes and AI‑powered practice tools at no cost.


- **Hilton expanded its no-cost Language Learning Program to more than 500,000 team members worldwide, including franchised hotels, corporate offices and managed properties.**
- **Through EF Corporate Learning, Hilton team members can access unlimited self-study courses and on-demand group classes in English, Spanish, French and German as well as unlimited self-study courses in Portuguese and Swedish.**
- **The program includes more than 2,300 AI-powered English conversation role plays with instant feedback, available on mobile and web.**
- **Nearly 10,000 team members across 73 countries have participated; more than 90% of enrollments come from frontline team members, and 69% are for English-language learning.**
- **The program enables Hilton team members to strengthen communication skills, build confidence, pursue career development and create more welcoming experiences for guests and colleagues.**


At Hilton, the ability to connect across cultures and languages is essential to delivering a welcoming guest experience. That’s why Hilton is expanding its Language Learning Program, giving more than 500,000 team members across its global workforce access to multilingual learning resources at no cost. By helping team members communicate more confidently with guests and colleagues, the program strengthens connections, fuels professional growth and supports Hilton’s[award-winning culture](https://stories.hilton.com/releases/hilton-named-no-1-on-worlds-best-workplaces-list-for-second-consecutive-year) of people serving people.


Initially launched last year for corporate and managed hotel team members, the program is now expanding across Hilton’s franchised team member population. The same core learning opportunities are available across roles and locations, with no manager approval required. Nearly 10,000 team members have participated to date, with more than 90% of enrollments coming from Hilton’s frontline workforce. Courses have been activated across 73 countries, with China, the United States, Turkey, Mexico and Egypt leading participation, and 69% of enrollments are for English-language learning.


Hilton offers language learning through[EF Corporate Learning](https://corporatelearning.ef.com/en/) , the world’s first and largest corporate language-training provider and proprietary AI technology developed by[Efekta Education](http://www.efekta.com/) , an education technology company founded by EF. Through the EF Language Live platform, team members can access their available courses, identify their starting level and get started with self-study and group classes immediately.


Through EF Corporate Learning’s custom EF Language Live platform, team members can access:


- Unlimited self-study courses in English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese and Swedish
- Unlimited on-demand group classes in English, Spanish, French and German
- More than 2,300 AI-powered English conversation role plays with instant feedback through mobile and web platforms


The benefit is already helping team members strengthen practical hospitality skills, from greeting guests and exchanging contact information to welcoming new colleagues. Eighty percent of those who sign up complete the enrollment and placement process, significantly higher than industry averages for an education benefit program. Among team members who participate in live group classes, 68% speak more often than the average EF student, and participants give their instructors an average rating of 4.93 out of 5.


Hilton will measure the program’s success by monitoring participation, classes and learning hours completed, along with real-time feedback from team members.


“We believe growth and connection should be accessible to every team member, no matter where they work or where they are in their career,” said Christine Maginnis, senior vice president, global head of talent and rewards, Hilton. “Language can open doors, build confidence and strengthen the human connections at the heart of hospitality. By expanding this program, we’re giving all our team members a practical way to invest in themselves and their future, while creating even stronger connections with colleagues and guests around the world.”


## Learning That Shows Up in the Stay


For team members, those new skills can translate into everyday moments with guests and colleagues, greater career opportunities and increased confidence.


**Gio, a team member at[Conrad Orlando](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/orlcici-conrad-orlando/)** , says the program has increased his confidence both at work and in his personal life.


“It is very important to learn a new language, especially now that we are speaking in English…I was very frustrated during meetings to understand my colleagues or I was very afraid that they would ask me questions because I didn’t know how to answer. Equally when I was tending to a guests I was fearful of those interactions. Now I have much more confidence. I can now speak and respond, I can understand and develop more in a dialogue or in conversation. It also helps me a lot outside of work; I was afraid to go to buy food somewhere because they didn’t understand me, and right now I feel confident.”


**Natalia, a Hilton**[LAUNCH analyst](https://stories.hilton.com/releases/team-members-rank-hilton-the-no-1-best-workplace-in-hotels-resorts) **,** recently used the offering ahead of a rotation at[Conrad Tokyo](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/tyocici-conrad-tokyo/) .


“Before coming to Japan, I knew nothing about the Japanese language. Hilton’s Language Learning Program gave me the confidence to connect meaningfully with guests and team members and helped me feel more prepared to be part of the team. Being able to communicate also helped me form friendships with colleagues and create more personal, welcoming moments for guests during my rotation.”


## Making the Ability to Connect More Accessible


The expansion reflects Hilton’s broader approach to team member development: making learning easier to access and relevant to team members across roles, locations and career stages.


Unlike development opportunities that require team members to be selected or nominated, Hilton’s core Language Learning offering is designed to be accessible across teams, roles and regions. Team members can choose how they learn — from independent study to live instruction and AI-powered practice — giving them the flexibility to fit development around their work and lives.


For Hilton, the goal extends beyond learning new vocabulary. It is about giving team members another way to build the skills and confidence that help them connect with people, pursue their development and bring Hilton’s culture of hospitality to life around the world. Hilton provides a number of benefits and resources to support professional development for team members at every stage of their career:


- **Lead Harvard:** Hilton’s leadership-development curriculum, created with Harvard Business Publishing, helps team members at different career stages strengthen critical capabilities — from managing teams and collaborating effectively to strategic thinking and decision-making. ****
- **Hilton University and LinkedIn Learning:** Team members have free access to nearly 30,000 courses and job certifications from leading education partners, helping them build in-demand skills and pursue development throughout their careers.
- **Guild:** Hilton was the first hospitality company to offer eligible U.S. team members tuition-free, barrier-free education through Guild. Available beginning on the first day of employment, offerings range from certificates and boot camps to GED, high school completions and associate and bachelor’s degrees.


Together, these programs reflect Hilton’s commitment to making career growth more accessible — whether a team member is learning a language, preparing to lead, earning a credential or pursuing a degree. That investment in people is central to Hilton’s workplace culture, recently recognized by[Fortune and Great Place To Work as the No. 1 World’s Best Workplace for the third time](https://stories.hilton.com/releases/hilton-named-no-1-on-worlds-best-workplaces-list-for-second-consecutive-year) . By investing in skills that support team members throughout their careers, Hilton is building a stronger workforce and helping its people deliver exceptional hospitality around the world. For more information about careers at Hilton, visit[jobs.hilton.com](https://jobs.hilton.com/) .


##### FAQ: Hilton Expands No-Cost Language Learning to All Team Members

Self-study courses cover English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese and Swedish, while group classes cover English, Spanish, French and German.


The program offers unlimited self-study courses, on-demand group classes and more than 2,300 AI-powered English conversation role plays with instant feedback.


Team members can access the program through single sign-on without manager approval.


It helps team members strengthen communication skills, build confidence, pursue career development and create more welcoming guest and colleague experiences.

## About Hilton


Hilton (Nasdaq: HLT) is a leading global hospitality company with a portfolio of 28 world-class brands comprising more than 9,600 properties and over 1.4 million rooms, in 144 countries and territories. Dedicated to fulfilling its founding vision to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality, Hilton has welcomed over 4 billion guests in its more than 100-year history. Named a three-time No. 1 World’s Best Workplace by Great Place to Work and Fortune, Hilton aims to create the best culture for its 500,000 team members around the world. Hilton has introduced industry-leading technology enhancements to improve the guest experience, including Digital Key Share, automated complimentary room upgrades and the ability to book confirmed connecting rooms. Through the award-winning guest loyalty program Hilton Honors, the more than 270 million Hilton Honors members who book directly with Hilton can earn Points for hotel stays and experiences money can't buy. With the free[Hilton Honors app](https://www.hilton.com/en/p/hilton-honors-mobile-app/) , guests can book their stay, select their room, check in, unlock their door with a Digital Key and check out, all from their smartphone.
